title: Weak Sounds and the Schwa
subtitle: Why English sounds fast to Brazilian learners
description: In Brazilian Portuguese, vowels are usually clear. In English, many vowels become weak and short. This makes listening difficult and speech sound unnatural.

categories.title: Weak Function Words
categories.description: Small grammar words are not stressed in English and become very short in normal speech.

sentences.sentence: I want to GO to the STORE.
This is a CUP of TEA.

categories.title: Schwa Inside Words
categories.description: Unstressed syllables inside words become weak and short in English.
